## Global Excellence in Animal Health

Bimeda Animal Health Ltd. develops and manufactures a wide range of veterinary pharmaceuticals,
vaccines and animal health products which are sold in more than eighty countries across six
continents. We focus on the development and delivery of products and services to optimize the health
and wellbeing of animals around the globe, including livestock, poultry, horses, companion animals
and aquatic animals.

Bimeda employs over 1,000 people globally and has 9 manufacturing facilities, 8 R&D facilities and
over 1,600 marketing authorisations.

## Global Excellence in Animal Health

Bimeda Animal Health Ltd. develops and manufactures a wide range of veterinary pharmaceuticals,
vaccines and animal health products which are sold in more than eighty countries across six
continents. We focus on the development and delivery of products and services to optimize the health
and wellbeing of animals around the globe, including livestock, poultry, horses, companion animals
and aquatic animals.

Bimeda employs over 1,000 people globally and has 9 manufacturing facilities, 8 R&D facilities and
over 1,600 marketing authorisations.

electrolyte systems, as well as specialty analyzers for immunoassay and coagulation parameters.

## In-House Diagnostics Products
* ### Element AIM™
  
  The industry’s only automated fecal and urine in-house lab.
  
  [Learn More][107]
* ### Element COAG+™
  
  Run PT and aPTT in the treatment room, operating room, or cage side.
  
  [Learn More][108]
* ### Element DC5X™
  
  Professional-grade clinical chemistry.
  
  [Learn More][109]
* ### Element DCX™
  
  Simple, fast, and flexible chemistry with superior accuracy.
  
  [Learn More][110]

  True five-part WBC differential plus reticulocytes in just 90 seconds.
  
  [Learn More][111]

  True five-part WBC differential, RBC, and platelet parameters, in under 60 seconds.
  
  [Learn More][112]

  The Element i+™ immunodiagnostic analyzer supports diagnostic needs with total T4, cortisol,
  progesterone, cTSH, cCRP, and the Nu.Q® cancer test.
  
  [Learn More][113]
* ### Element POC™
  
  Handheld blood chemistry, electrolytes, hematology, acid-base, and blood gas analyzer.
  
  [Learn More][114]

  HeskaView Cloud and PIMS Software Solutions.
  
  [Learn More][115]

  Digital cytology consultations with board-certified clinical pathologists who can assist in
  evaluating your patients.
  
  [Learn More][116]

  Empowering veterinary care teams with the industry’s only in-house canine cancer blood test.
  
  [Learn More][117]

  Rapid in-house FIV/FeLV detection for every practice.
  
  [Learn More][118]

  [Learn More][119]

  [Learn More][120]

## **Disease in Dogs**

Heart disease in dogs affects heart function and circulation. It can be something a dog is born with
or something they develop over time due to wear, injury, or infection. Even young dogs are at risk.
Regular vet check-ups are crucial for early detection and management.

[ Read More ][20]
Image
[doggy]

#### What are the most common heart diseases in dogs?
* **Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease (MMVD)**: A progressive condition where the mitral valve, a
  valve that helps control one-way blood flow between chambers of the heart, becomes thickened and
  misshapen, leading to leakage and heart enlargement. It's most common in small breeds, especially
  older Cavalier King Charles Spaniels.
* **Dilated Cardiomyopathy (DCM)**: A disease of the heart muscle where muscle walls thin and the
  chambers become enlarged. It primarily affects large breeds like Dobermans, Boxers, and Great
  Danes.
* **Congenital Heart Defects**: These are present at birth and can include conditions like patent
  ductus arteriosus (PDA), pulmonic stenosis, and aortic stenosis. PDA occurs when blood is
  redirected back to the lungs and can cause fluid build-up and may eventually lead to heart
  failure. Aortic and Pulmonic stenosis are the narrowing of critical heart valves and may cause the
  heart muscle to thicken and eventually lead to heart failure.

#### What breeds are at risk of Heart Failure due to MMVD?

MMVD is the most common type of heart disease in dogs, particularly in small to medium-sized breeds.
Dogs with this type of heart disease develop distorted heart valves, which no longer close properly.
Veterinarians can hear the backward blood flow, referred to as a heart murmur, with a stethoscope.

Predisposed dog breeds:
* Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
* Chihuahua
* Dachshund
* Maltese
* Miniature Poodle
* Miniature Schnauzer
* Shih Tzu

This is not a complete list of at-risk breeds.

#### What breeds are at risk of Heart Failure due to DCM?

DCM is a condition most commonly seen in larger-breed dogs. The heart and the heart muscle of dogs
with DCM is stretched and thinned along with the heart structure, resulting in the heart being
unable to effectively pump blood.

Predisposed dog breeds:
* Cocker Spaniel
* Doberman Pinscher
* Golden Retriever
* Great Dane
* Irish Wolfhound
* Labrador Retriever

This is not a complete list of at-risk breeds

#### What are common signs to look out for?

In the early stages of the disease your dog will show no symptoms and not all dogs will go into
heart failure. Depending on how severe a dog’s congestive heart failure is, symptoms may occur when
a dog is resting, during mild exercise, or during moderate or extreme exertion. If any of these
signs are noted in your dog, contact your vet as soon as possible.

Clinical signs can include:
* Coughing, especially during or after exercise or while resting
* Difficulty breathing or rapid, shallow breathing
* Tiring easily during physical activity or exercise intolerance
* Lethargy or weakness
* Decreased appetite or weight loss
* Abdominal distension or bloating
* Restlessness, pacing, or discomfort
* Fainting or collapse in severe cases

# Purpose

We are a global community of scientists, veterinarians, producers and many others united by our
singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Together, we are
helping to shape a healthier future—for animals, for people, for our planet, for all of us. This
commitment defines us as colleagues and as a business.

[Learn More][113]
[Close-up of an automated lab pipetting instrument dispensing into tubes, with a Zoetis researcher
in a lab coat blurred in the background holding a clipboard - Zoetis]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]

laboratory corridor - Zoetis]

INNOVATORS FOR ANIMALS

# Real Stories, Revolutionary Science

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.

# Purpose

We are a global community of scientists, veterinarians, producers and many others united by our
singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Together, we are
helping to shape a healthier future—for animals, for people, for our planet, for all of us. This
commitment defines us as colleagues and as a business.

[Learn More][113]
[Close-up of an automated lab pipetting instrument dispensing into tubes, with a Zoetis researcher
in a lab coat blurred in the background holding a clipboard - Zoetis]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]
[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and
smile near a large window - Zoetis]

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.

`// Initialize CRMBridge API
const crmbridge = require('@crmbridge/api');

crmbridge.configure({
  apiKey: process.env.CRMBRIDGE_API_KEY,
  environment: 'production'
});

// Fetch patient with imaging data
const patient = await crmbridge.patients.get('patient_123', {
  include: ['appointments', 'xrays', 'treatment_history']
});

// Access X-ray images
const xrays = patient.imaging.xrays;
xrays.forEach(xray => {
  console.log(`X-ray: ${xray.type} - ${xray.date}`);

});

// Sync appointment to PMS
await crmbridge.appointments.create({
  patient_id: 'patient_123',
  provider_id: 'provider_456',
  start_time: '2025-11-15T09:00:00',
  type: 'cleaning',
  sync_to_pms: true
});`

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

## The Value of Livestock Vaccination

Behind every healthy herd and thriving farm is a simple but powerful tool: vaccination.

By protecting livestock from preventable diseases, vaccination helps farmers reduce losses, improve
productivity, safeguard their livelihoods, and build more resilient farming systems.

[ The race for livestock vaccination in rural Africa ][58]

### Animals & Us: GALVmed's Story

The series Animals & Us explores the strong connection between the health of animals and people. In
GALVmed’s film, we explore how innovation, collaboration, and vaccination of livestock help protect
animals, strengthen communities, and advance One Health.

This video was produced for GALVmed by BBC StoryWorks Commercial Productions.

### Year in Review: GALVmed 2025

We’re excited to share **GALVmed’s 2025 Year in Review**, an overview of our accomplishments and the
progress made throughout the year in advancing our mission.

The review reflects a year of meaningful impact and our continued commitment to strengthening
livelihoods through improved livestock health.

Read it [here][59].

### Our Vision

Transformational improvement in the well-being and economic progression of small-scale livestock
producers.

### Our Mission

We will contribute to the transformation of small-scale livestock producers’ lives by:
* understanding the constraints to animal health and how to overcome them;
* engaging the animal health industry; and
* ensuring awareness, availability and adoption of effective animal health interventions.

[[• Approximately 8.6 million cumulative annual customers over the period 2014 to 2025, before
adjustment for potential repeat customers • Approximately US$157.9 million in poultry deaths
averted, from 2014 to 2025 • 3.89 billion doses of livestock vaccines, therapeutics and other animal
health products sold to small-scale producers across Africa and South Asia from 2014 to 2025 • 16
products taken to full development since 2010 • 24 products registered to date under the Mutual
Recognition Procedure • US$583.2 million in total net economic benefits to SSPs from the sale of
vaccines and animal health products. Of this, US$260.1 million represents additional net economic
benefit generated through GALVmed’s efforts to expand market availability and catalyse new adoption.
]][60]

## Our work

[ Product development ][61]

GALVmed specialises in product development partnerships uniquely established to translate global
research progress into tangible livestock disease control tools for the developing world.

[ Commercial development ][62]

Our work with our partners supports the small-scale livestock producers of the world.

[ Enabling environment ][63]

An enabling environment that allows for the successful translation of research products to
sustainable animal health solutions for small scale livestock producers is essential to achieving
GALVmed’s mission.

About Gros Imports

## A global outsourcing partner built on trust and results

Since 2013, we have helped businesses across 42 countries streamline operations, source reliably,
and grow internationally. Our approach combines local expertise with a global network.

### Our Mission

To empower businesses worldwide with reliable outsourcing solutions that reduce operational
complexity, lower costs, and free our clients to focus on what they do best.

### Our Vision

To be the most trusted international outsourcing partner, recognized for integrity, quality, and the
measurable impact we create for every client we serve.

### Our Core Values

The principles that guide every decision we make.

#### Integrity

We operate with transparency and honesty in every interaction, from supplier negotiations to client
reporting.

#### Excellence

We hold ourselves to international standards and continuously refine our processes to deliver better
outcomes.

#### Partnership

We treat your success as our own, investing in long-term relationships rather than transactional
engagements.

#### Innovation

We apply technology and data-driven methods to make sourcing, procurement, and logistics more
efficient.

Gros Imports is established with a focus on import-export consulting for Finnish SMEs.

2015

Grew our supplier network across the EU and began offering procurement services at scale.

2018

#### Launched BPO Division

Added business process outsourcing, customer support, and virtual assistance to our portfolio.

2020

#### Asia & Africa Operations

Opened sourcing operations in Asia and established partnerships across African markets.

2023

#### North American Presence

Expanded into North America, bringing our integrated trade support to a global client base.

2025

#### 42 Countries Served

Today we serve clients across 42 countries with a network of 320+ verified business partners.

reporting.

We hold ourselves to international standards and continuously refine our processes to deliver better
outcomes.

We treat your success as our own, investing in long-term relationships rather than transactional
engagements.

#### Innovation

We apply technology and data-driven methods to make sourcing, procurement, and logistics more
efficient.

### State of the art Veterinary Health Care Centre

Niti Bagh Pet Clinic is a well-established, full-service, small animal veterinary practice providing
comprehensive
pet medical, surgical and diagnostic care since 1990.

###### Veterinary OPD

Your pet is an important part of the family, and when they are ill, you want the best available
medical care. We are ready to provide your pet with comprehensive veterinary medical care - from
wellness exams and vaccines to parasite control and nutrition, your pet will receive the highest
quality care.

###### Diagnostics

At Niti Bagh Pet Clinic, we are equipped to provide the most current diagnostic, laboratory and
therapeutic services. We offer on-site x-rays, ultrasounds, electrocardiographs and other
diagnostics to care for your pets' complete health care needs.

###### Vaccinations & Deworming

Pets today can live longer, healthier lives than ever before—in part because of vaccines that help
protect them from deadly infectious diseases. The vets at Niti bagh Pet Clinic will administer the
vaccines and dewormings for your pets.

###### Treatment & Surgeries

We have state-of-the-art surgical facilities including spaying, neutering, mass removal, orthopedic
procedures and more. We utilize the safest available anesthetics to provide that extra margin of
safety, especially for our older or high risk patients.

### Niti Bagh Pet Clinic Veterinarians

The talented pool of Veterinarians, diverse in vet protocols, united in the pet care mission.
Niti Bagh Pet Clinic ensures that animal welfare standards are kept high by enabling veterinarians
to regularly attend CE programs.

### State of the art Veterinary Health Care Centre

Niti Bagh Pet Clinic is a well-established, full-service, small animal veterinary practice providing
comprehensive
pet medical, surgical and diagnostic care since 1990.

###### Veterinary OPD

Your pet is an important part of the family, and when they are ill, you want the best available
medical care. We are ready to provide your pet with comprehensive veterinary medical care - from
wellness exams and vaccines to parasite control and nutrition, your pet will receive the highest
quality care.

###### Diagnostics

At Niti Bagh Pet Clinic, we are equipped to provide the most current diagnostic, laboratory and
therapeutic services. We offer on-site x-rays, ultrasounds, electrocardiographs and other
diagnostics to care for your pets' complete health care needs.

###### Vaccinations & Deworming

Pets today can live longer, healthier lives than ever before—in part because of vaccines that help
protect them from deadly infectious diseases. The vets at Niti bagh Pet Clinic will administer the
vaccines and dewormings for your pets.

We have state-of-the-art surgical facilities including spaying, neutering, mass removal, orthopedic
procedures and more. We utilize the safest available anesthetics to provide that extra margin of
safety, especially for our older or high risk patients.

Niti Bagh Pet Clinic ensures that animal welfare standards are kept high by enabling veterinarians
to regularly attend CE programs.

# Welcome to
# Oaksedge Sanctuary

A dedicated haven for rescued animals in Derbyshire. Join us in our mission to provide love and care
to those who cannot speak for themselves.

[Donate Here][9]
[att_edited_edited.jpg]

Nestled within the rolling countryside of Derbyshire’s Peak District, Oaksedge Farm Sanctuary is a
peaceful animal sanctuary dedicated to rescue, rehabilitation and compassionate lifelong care.


What began as a derelict farmhouse and overgrown land has slowly evolved into a safe haven for more
than 250 rescued animals. Today, Oaksedge Sanctuary provides refuge to animals rescued from factory
farming systems, abandonment, neglect and uncertain futures - offering them space, safety and the
chance to simply live naturally.

[att.UACWKs0zwOHwNAIsqhmqko5bl7lKvWK1NI58ADSwQFo-2.jpg]

Surrounded by wildflower meadows, woodland, a nature reserve and open countryside, the sanctuary is
also undergoing an ongoing rewilding project designed to support biodiversity and restore natural
habitats for native wildlife.


Every animal at Oaksedge has their own story. Some arrive nervous and unsure, others require ongoing
medical care or rehabilitation. What they are all given is patience, consistency and a lifelong
commitment to their wellbeing.

# The animals at Oaksedge Sanctuary

# Rewilding

Alongside the rescue and rehabilitation work we carry out for animals, rewilding plays an important
role in the future of Oaksedge Sanctuary.


Across the sanctuary, we are gradually restoring natural habitats through wildflower meadows,
protected woodland areas, wildlife support initiatives and more sustainable land management
practices designed to encourage biodiversity and help native wildlife thrive.


Our vision is to create a space where rescued animals, nature and the surrounding landscape can
exist together in balance - allowing the land to slowly recover and flourish once again.

[20260629_194142.jpg]

# The Vision

The vision for Oaksedge Sanctuary has always been simple: to create a safe, sustainable sanctuary
where animals can live free from fear, exploitation or expectation.


Alongside rescue and rehabilitation, the sanctuary is committed to rewilding the surrounding land to
encourage biodiversity and restore balance between animals, wildlife and the environment.


Future plans include expanding rescue facilities, improving habitats, increasing educational
outreach and continuing to grow the sanctuary’s long-term impact within animal welfare and
conservation.
 

[Donate Here][10]

# How to get involved

There are many ways to support the ongoing work here at Oaksedge Sanctuary. Whether through
donations, volunteering, professional partnerships or corporate sponsorship, every contribution
helps us continue providing lifelong care to rescued animals while supporting the future growth of
the sanctuary and its rewilding projects.


Donate

Support daily animal care, veterinary treatment, rescue work, maintenance and future sanctuary
expansion through financial contributions of any size.


Volunteer

Join the hands-on work happening across the sanctuary, from animal care and feeding to gardening,
maintenance and enrichment.


Professional Partnerships

We welcome support from veterinary professionals, suppliers, tradespeople, landscapers and local
businesses who can offer services, expertise or resources.


Corporate Sponsorship

Partner with Oaksedge Sanctuary through meaningful sponsorship opportunities including CSR
initiatives, team volunteering days, PR collaboration and brand visibility across the sanctuary’s
platforms.

[Find out more][11]
[IMG_0905.JPEG]

# Ethical Eggs

At Oaksedge Sanctuary, we offer a small selection of ethical eggs laid by our rescued hens, ducks,
quail and turkeys living freely within the sanctuary grounds.

Our animals are never valued based on productivity. Instead, they are given lifelong care, space to
roam naturally and the freedom to live at their own pace, regardless of whether they continue laying
eggs.

The eggs we collect help provide an important source of income for the sanctuary, directly
supporting feed, bedding, veterinary care and the ongoing rescue and rehabilitation work we carry
out every day.


Available eggs may include:


Hen eggs 

Duck eggs 

Quail eggs 

Turkey eggs


Availability naturally varies throughout the seasons and always depends on the wellbeing of the
animals in our care.


Eggs are available to buy directly at Oaksedge Sanctuary (delivery is currently not available).

We are currently in the final stages of securing official charity status for Oaksedge Sanctuary.


This is an incredibly important and exciting next step for the future of the sanctuary. Becoming a

Eggs are available to buy directly at Oaksedge Sanctuary (delivery is currently not available).

# Oaksedge Charity Status

We are currently in the final stages of securing official charity status for Oaksedge Sanctuary.


This is an incredibly important and exciting next step for the future of the sanctuary. Becoming a
registered charity will allow us to expand our rescue work, improve facilities, secure structured
funding opportunities and provide long-term support for even more animals.


Everything achieved so far has been built through community support, volunteers and a shared belief
in creating something meaningful for animals who deserve a second chance.

 

We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who has supported Oaksedge so far and helped us reach this
stage - thank you for being part of the journey.

their own pace.


From rescued farm animals and birds to small animals requiring ongoing care, each resident is
treated as an individual, with compassion, patience and lifelong wellbeing at the heart of
everything we do.

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert
analysis across all healthcare segments.

[ Learn about Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting ][11]

### Customer Insights

We provide high-quality Syndicated and Custom Research insights using statistic-representation of
data by synthesizing a range of secondary and primary sources.

### Market Databook

Availability of Market Databook with proven historical numbers along with the driven market
estimation data through strategic implementation, and availability of feasible tools to determine
the market opportunity and potential impact.

### Company Profiles

Detailed information of company and industry profiles, financial data, investment insights, business
